name: Aviary Tax AMM
description: Constant-product markets that take a buy and a sell tax in one chosen mint, the tax side, whichever way a trade goes. Every tax is capped by a limit compiled into the program, and can only move inside a range fixed at creation, by an optional tax authority that can also renounce. Liquidity is seeded once and locked for good. The tax is booked in the market's vault and paid out to the market's tax recipients and burn, after the suite share.

init.description: Creates a tax market for two tokens. The market state is a new keypair, which signs. Add the router's init_fee_account for each mint and the seed action in the same transaction, so the market opens as it is created.

seed_liquidity.description: For a launchpad graduating a token: its program calls pipeline_seed_liquidity, which creates a tax market, takes the seed from the launchpad's escrows and opens it, all in one call. SeedRequest.amounts is the most to take from each escrow, in mint order: each above 0, except the virtual side's when the market has a virtual reserve. SeedRequest.data is these arguments, Borsh-encoded in order, exactly as init's: the same creation parameters under the same rules, except the seeder, which is the calling program's PDA that signs. Accounts: Pipeline's fixed seed accounts (the seeder, the market state below, the payer, the system program and an LP recipient, which is ignored since a tax market issues no LP shares), then mint, escrow and token program for each mint, then the accounts below, then any transfer-hook accounts. Returns SeedResult with lp_amount 0. Follow it in the same transaction with the router's register_existing_market (no info accounts after the market state) and init_fee_account for each mint. The market state is keyed by the seeder and the mints in the order given, so a seeder seeds each ordered pair of mints once; the same mints in the other order would make another market.

actions.name: seed
actions.label: Seed liquidity
actions.description: The market's seeder funds it, once, before any swap, and it opens for trading. The liquidity is locked for good: nothing can ever take it out. A side may be left empty only when its virtual reserve prices it.

actions.name: distribute
actions.label: Pay out a tax slot
actions.description: Anyone pays out everything one tax recipient (slots 0 to 3) or the suite share (slot 5) is owed, in the market's tax-side mint, to the associated token account of the slot's wallet, which is created at the caller's expense when it is missing; a tax side of native SOL is paid as wrapped SOL. Inputs: tax_mint is the market's tax-side mint, and recipient the slot's wallet, read from the market state (the suite treasury's for slot 5). A slot owed nothing moves nothing. The burn slot is paid out with the burn action. Add the tax-side mint's transfer-hook accounts after these.

args.name: slot
args.label: Slot
args.description: 0 to 3 a tax recipient, 5 the suite share. An unused recipient slot is refused.

actions.name: burn
actions.label: Burn the burn slot's tax
actions.description: Anyone burns everything the burn slot (slot 4) is owed from the market's vault, lowering the tax-side mint's supply. This is the distribute instruction for slot 4, with the mint writable, which only the burn needs, so the tax recipients' payouts never write-lock the mint. Inputs: tax_mint is the market's tax-side mint, and recipient the default (all-zero) key, 11111111111111111111111111111111, since the burn pays no wallet. A burn slot owed nothing burns nothing.

args.name: slot
args.label: Slot
args.description: Always 4, the burn slot.

actions.name: set_taxes
actions.label: Change the taxes
actions.description: The market's tax authority sets the buy and sell tax, each inside the range fixed at creation, which no tax can ever leave. The next swap pays the new rates; a trade quoted before the change is protected by its minimum output.

args.name: buy_tax_bps
args.label: Buy tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the input when the tax side is sold into the market. Inside its range.

args.name: sell_tax_bps
args.label: Sell tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the output when the tax side is bought from the market. Inside its range.

actions.name: set_recipients
actions.label: Change the tax recipients
actions.description: The market's tax authority replaces the tax recipients, their shares and the burn share, under the same rules as at creation. What each slot is already owed stays with the slot and goes to the wallet it names when paid out, so pay a leaving recipient out first.
